# Copilot instructions for keebdex/aviary

The shared instructions for every AI coding agent live in
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read and follow them before
making changes; they cover the layout, the rules every job follows, and the code
conventions.

## Copilot specifics

- Keep suggestions typed and in the ruff style configured in `pyproject.toml`;
  Copilot does not run the repository's pre-commit hooks.
